contract.request: 최적화 커널 여러 개 넣고 magic2가 실제로 빨라지는지도 비교 실행

criteria.statement: At least three equivalent kernel candidates with exact uint32 results, tails, unaligned vector starts and guard checks.
Compare ordinary compiler-optimized C, each fixed candidate and real cold/warm Magic2 selection; record actual selected plans and fallback routes with identical work, grain and one-P budget.

Run nine fresh-process paired samples with balanced order and discarded process warmups; retain raw results, setup/training costs, source hashes and commands; speedup is an observation, not a required positive outcome.
Verify warning-as-error Make build, CMake target registration, kernel self-test including ASan/UBSan, existing Magic2 regressions, intended diff and task-owned cleanup.

constraints: Preserve existing user changes and preceding comparison.
No runtime/public ABI or Magic2 selection algorithm modifications.
No disabled baseline compiler optimizations or fabricated training observations.
No new dependency installations, full runtime rebuilds or unrelated tests.
